Maintain paws' lowest contact at y628/640 and anatomical hip center around x174/448; do not zoom whole character. Shorter feline torso and softly bent supporting foreleg bring shoulders down; jacket/tie/skirt follow this compact body. Preserve image1 action: anatomical right forepaw crosses chest to the red breast badge; left forepaw grounded; both rear haunches supporting. Four actual attached feline limbs exactly once, one fluffy brown tail, black blazer/white collar/red tie/red plaid hip skirt/red breast patch and pink X clip on anatomical left ear. Matte soft fabric, same fur material. No new accessory, no effects/companion/text. True transparent background. Same portrait7:10 canvas with complete ears/tail/paws and headroom. One independent cell only. Do not stretch skull or redraw face into a different cat. Crucial change is shorter torso by ~40/640 of canvas, not a differently sized head.
